name: Refugee Influx
desc: Large numbers of displaced people are arriving here from unstable worlds across the sector. Some are in search of a home and even have useful skills while others seek only to take advantage of those around them.

name: Fecund Soil
desc: The soil here is unusually rich and fertile. Particularly odd for a planet with widespread jungle-class growth.

name: Aggressive Megafauna
desc: From extremely territorial herds of large herbivores to the predators that hunt them, much of the large fauna is as unwelcoming to colonists as the plant and insect life.

name: Corrupted Farmland
desc: The once verdant fields of Gilead have been corrupted by fire and fallout from the heavens.

name: Red Tide
desc: PLACEHOLDER (author text pending): Each warm season for several years now, blooms of toxic algae have spread across Volturn's shallow seas, staining the water rust-brown and choking the fish stocks its aquaculture depends on. Diktat bulletins call it a passing seasonal nuisance. The fishing crews, hauling up empty nets, call it a red tide. Only the sealed and filtered lobster pens have been spared.

name: Religious Unrest
desc: Large and sometimes violent protests by splinter factions of the Luddic faith are causing civil unrest. Best to keep your guards with you at all times.

name: Crusade Mobilization
desc: The entire local economy has been bent toward the Crusade's war effort. Civilian production, safety protocols, technical maintenance, and long-term population health have all been sacrificed in favor of immediate output. The result is impressive, brutal, and unsustainable.

name: Pariah Colony
desc: Shunned by the rest of the sector, these people struggle to find anyone willing to trade with them. Barely able to import what they need or export their meager production, they are scraping by as best they can.

name: Destitute Population
desc: This enclave can only offer poor payment for goods, but the refugees appreciate those willing to trade with them.

name: Refugee Strain
desc: Displaced people from nearby worlds are overwhelming this colony's resources. Markets are overrun with petty crime, begging and the desperate fighting for scraps. The situation is throttling trade, and driving up prices.

name: Refugee Encampments
desc: Displaced people from a convoy in orbit have spread through the docks and set up makeshift camps. Local services are strained, necessities are scarce, and those willing to sign onto almost any ship are everywhere.

name: Corsair Activity
desc:
Black Fleet corsairs are hunting shipping on the routes into this market.
Imports are strangled -- freighters go missing, insurers refuse the route,
and the captains still willing to run it charge accordingly.

name: Business is Good
desc: The station's holds are overflowing and fences are happy to make a deal. Goods are going cheap--- Just don't ask which colony they were stored at last month.

name: Sacked
desc: Black Fleet corsairs put troops on the ground here. The strike was organized and brutal, warehouses emptied and burned, armories stripped, and half the spaceport guards are dead or missing. Trade is limping back -- but everyone in the sector knows this world can't defend itself.

name: Business is Business
desc: Prices here have spiked across the board. Merchants shrug, muttering about overheads and the cost of doing business before quickly changing the subject.

name: Crusade Strike
desc: Something went up in the warehouse district. No one saw anything and only a hurriedly painted symbol of the Ashen Crusade was left behind. Replacement shipments are on the way, but until then certain supplies are at a premium.

name: Relief Shipment
desc: An Ashen Crusade aid convoy has unloaded food, medicine and necessities here. The enclave is quieter for it, but partly because the Crusade's recruiters came down the ramps with the cargo. Many of those strong enough to work or angry enough to fight joined them when they left.

name: Crusade Harassment
desc: Ashen Crusade raiders are working the approaches to this market. They have not come for plunder. Ships coming and going from port are simply attacked and destroyed. Shipping has declined badly, even worse, so have profits.

name: Emergency Measures
desc: Local authorities have hired emergency security forces, requisitioned weapons and supplies, and imposed extraordinary appropriations in an attempt to restore order.

name: Wartime Interdiction
desc: Warships are working the approaches to this market. They fire on any hint of opposition or collaboration. Traders have quietly stopped filing routes here.

name: Blockade Spillover
desc: PLACEHOLDER (author text pending): a foreign war has closed the jump points above this colony. The blockading fleets have no quarrel with it, and turn its traffic back all the same.

name: Planetary Blockade
desc: PLACEHOLDER (author text pending): warships of a foreign power are holding station over this world. Nothing lifts from the surface without their leave, and what does reach the docks is sold at whatever the shortage will bear.

name: Relief Effort
desc: PLACEHOLDER (author text pending): a government relief convoy is unloading here. Salvage crews, spare parts and replacement stock are going ashore, and the damage done to this world's installations is slowly being repaired.
